description:
Activate a Food by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token, a Food token, a Clue token and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2, as the Treasure is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
